craft_notes: Sthāyin: vision — sense-wheel host. Rows: seeing then throning. Rejected: singular goddess — killed: adjudicated plural predicate. Read aloud: bright roll.

lines: See the body-housed goddesses — thrill and trembling in mind's wealth —
the goddess-host throned in ear, eye, mouth, and nose.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dehasthā devatāḥ paśyan hlādodvegādi ciddhane karṇākṣimukhanāsādicakrasthaṃ devatāgaṇam
